lines.text: Jane gets this text. Should she pay?
Cloud checkers read your private messages. Small models miss the hard ones.
Shortstop fields it first. When unsure, it throws to first base, secrets masked.
Harder one. Shortstop isn't sure, so it throws to first base. Only the masked text goes to the cloud. It never sees Jane's name or account.
Now a real delivery notice. Safe. It doesn't cry wolf.
John gets a bank e-mail. One letter is off. Shortstop flags it before he clicks.
John pastes a lease into an AI chat. Same engine, outgoing. Names and numbers stay home.
Same engine on Android. Share the text, get the verdict, send it to family.
On 150 unseen messages: 98% of scams caught, 82% never left the laptop, one private value out of 348 sent.
Shortstop. Small model first. Your secrets stay home.
